editor.no_date_set: Set an end date in the block settings to show this timer
editor.untracked_inventory: Inventory is not tracked for this variant, so nothing is shown
editor.announcement_pages: This bar is set to show on some pages only; the editor shows it everywhere so you can edit it.
editor.atc_no_product: Pick a product, or place this block where a product is in context.
editor.countdown_ended: This countdown has ended and is hidden from shoppers.
editor.empty_section: Add blocks to show content here.
editor.mega_unmatched: Mega menu "{{ item }}": no top-level menu item with child links has this title, so the panel is not shown.
editor.review_stars_no_source: Add a source link so shoppers can check this rating. Nothing shows until you do.
editor.stars_no_source: Stars appear once a product with a review rating is in context, or when a source link is set.
editor.choose_product: Choose a product in this section's settings to replace the example.
editor.block_empty: This block is empty. Fill in its settings to show it here.
editor.tier_mismatch: Editor check: “{{ title }}” should take {{ expected }} off each item, but the cart line got {{ actual }}. Check the automatic discount in Shopify admin. Shoppers never see this note.
editor.tier_needs_title: Add the automatic discount's name to show the discounted price.
editor.no_tiers: Add Quantity tier blocks to show tier cards. The stepper shows until then.
editor.popup_no_page: Pick a page in the block settings to show it in a popup.
editor.complementary_empty: Complementary products show here once you choose them for this product in the Shopify Search & Discovery app.
editor.untitled_tab: Untitled tab: add a heading or pick a page.
editor.payment_badges_empty: No payment icons to show. Enable payment methods in your admin, check the filter, or upload images.
editor.rating_missing: Stars appear once your review app fills in this product's rating. Shoppers see nothing until then.
editor.platform_badge_no_url: Add a source link to show the rating number and stars. Without it, only the text and logo show.
editor.reviews_list_empty: Add at least one quote, or add your review app's block to this section instead.
editor.urgency_no_variant: Pick a product to preview this stock line.
editor.urgency_no_stock: Hidden: the selected variant has no stock left.
editor.urgency_above_threshold: Hidden: the selected variant has {{ stock }} in stock, above your threshold of {{ threshold }}.
editor.ship_hidden: Hidden from shoppers while the selected variant is sold out or does not need shipping.
editor.ship_no_window: Set processing or delivery days above 0 to show estimated dates.
editor.field_no_label: Add a label to show this field.
editor.size_chart_empty: Choose a page or an image to show the size chart.
editor.code_empty: Enter a code you created under Discounts to show this block.
editor.bundle_empty: Pick at least one product other than this one to show the bundle.
editor.upsells_empty: Pick products to show here, or switch to Shopify recommendations.
editor.gift_empty: Choose a gift product with an available variant to show this block.
editor.ship_bar_hidden: The free shipping bar is hidden: set a minimum in your store currency, and add a line for each market that uses another currency.
editor.checkpoints_hidden: Add checkpoint amounts, lowest first. The bar only shows in your store currency.
editor.gift_not_ready: Pick an available gift product and the cart total that unlocks it. A sold-out gift is never promised, and the gift is only added in your store currency.
editor.audio_no_file: Add an audio file link in this section's settings. Shoppers see nothing until you do.
editor.audio_not_file: This link does not end in an audio file type such as .mp3, so it may not play.
editor.bundle_list_mode: Products come from the product list, so the slot blocks are not shown. Switch “Products from” to use them.

bundle_short.one: This bundle asks for {{ count }} product but only {{ available }} can be picked here. Add products or lower “Products to pick”.
bundle_short.other: This bundle asks for {{ count }} products but only {{ available }} can be picked here. Add products or lower “Products to pick”.

editor.bundle_badge_hidden: Badge hidden from shoppers: tick “Badge is backed by sales data” in the section settings to show it.
editor.columns_over_four: A row holds up to 4 columns, so extra columns start a new row. Set Columns per row on desktop to choose the row length.
editor.untitled_row: Untitled row: add a label in this block's settings. Shoppers do not see rows without one.
editor.compare_stars_no_source: Add a source link to show these stars. Until then shoppers see the text or a dash.
editor.compare_rating_missing: No review rating found: pick a product with a rating from your review app, or use this section on a product page. Shoppers see the text or a dash.
editor.custom_liquid_blank: Add Liquid or HTML in this section's settings to show it here.
editor.custom_liquid_silent: Your code printed nothing on this page. Check its conditions, or preview a page where they apply. Shoppers never see this note.
editor.custom_liquid_invisible: This code shows no text or media here. If it only loads a script (a chat widget or tracking tag, for example), set Top padding and Bottom padding to 0 so shoppers do not see an empty band. Shoppers never see this note.
editor.feature_grid_link_hidden: Add a heading or a button label to show this card's link. Shoppers do not see this note.
editor.choose_products: Choose a collection or products in this section's settings to replace the example cards.
editor.collection_empty: This collection or product list has no products to show, so shoppers do not see this section.
editor.slide_link_name: Add a slide link name or image alt text. Without one, screen readers announce this link as “Open slide {{ index }}”. Shoppers never see this note.

image_marquee_link_needs_alt.one: 1 linked image has no alt text, so it is not a link yet. Add alt text to the block or the image.
image_marquee_link_needs_alt.other: {{ count }} linked images have no alt text, so they are not links yet. Add alt text to the block or the image.

editor.logo_link_needs_alt: Add alt text to a linked logo so its link works. Shoppers never see this note.
editor.slider_autoplay_video: Auto-advance is off because a slide holds a video, so videos never slide away on their own. Shoppers never see this note.
editor.popup_pages: Shoppers don't see this popup on this page because of the Pages setting. The editor shows it so you can edit it.
editor.pricing_badge_hidden: Badge hidden from shoppers: tick “Badge is backed by sales data” in this plan to show it.
editor.pricing_note_example: This plan's price now comes from the linked product. Update the price note so it matches how this product is billed.
editor.related_products_example: Example cards. The editor always shows these. Shoppers see Shopify's recommendations for this product here, and nothing at all when there are none.
editor.review_wall_no_source: Stars stay hidden on reviews without their own link. Add the link to where the customer posted each review so shoppers can check its stars.
editor.review_wall_summary_preview: Editor preview: shoppers see this line once you add the platform link. Type the rating and count exactly as the platform shows them.
editor.social_cards_no_counts: Counts and the network icon show only on posts that link to the original. Type each count as that post shows it; counts never update by themselves.
editor.track_order_template: Enter your carrier's tracking address, starting with https:// and containing {number}, to show the tracking form.
editor.track_order_embed: Paste the embed code from your tracking app to show it here.
editor.track_order_accounts: Customer accounts are turned off (Settings > Customer accounts), so shoppers do not see the order link.
editor.video_empty: Pick a video, or paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, to show it here.
editor.video_no_cover: Add a cover image. Nothing is fetched from YouTube or Vimeo before play, so shoppers see a plain placeholder until they press play.

palette_preview.title: Theme colours preview
palette_preview.intro: Every colour scheme from Theme settings > Colors, painted as the theme draws it, with the WCAG 2 contrast ratio of each colour pair. Only you see this, in the theme editor.
palette_preview.pair_accent: Links and focus ring on background
palette_preview.pair_button_hover: Button colour as hover text (outline style)
palette_preview.badges_note: Badge colours are set once for the whole theme in Theme settings > Colors, so they are checked here on their own: badge text on badge colour.
palette_preview.gradient_note: This scheme has a background gradient. The ratios use its solid background colour, so check text over the gradient by eye.
palette_preview.legend: Text needs 4.5:1 for AA or 7:1 for AAA; large text (24 px, or about 19 px bold) needs 3:1. Field borders and icons need 3:1. Ratios are rounded down to two decimals. A colour with transparency is measured over its scheme's solid background.
palette_preview.restyle: To change these colours, edit the schemes in Theme settings > Colors, or switch the theme style.
